Extrapolating from recent progress, we should expect further transformative capabilities as we enter the ~0.68-0.7 log-perplexity window.” this chart is one of the most beautiful ways to tell the story of the last 4 years. it also shows that a lot of the post training issues we debate is kinda the B plot to the overall A plot of large scale pretrain progress.

What board game should I get for Black Friday? Looking for something very replayable with my wife and 8 year old and ideally 30-40 min long. Quick reviews of ones I've tried (maybe some hot takes in here): Splendor: Very fun and replayable. Has just the right amount of strategy. Love how well made the chips are. Azul: Beautiful game and also very replayable. Just the right amount of interaction. Rummikub: I guess this is not really a board game but it's super replayable and fun. Even my 5 year old can play it. Ticket to Ride: It's pretty fun but you can really screw someone over if you take their route. Clue: Fun even though it's a bit simple. My kids loves it. Catan: Meh a bit too much luck involved Wingspan: Probably the most beautiful game but it's not super interactive. Cascadia: Also beautiful but not very interactive. Monopoly: Terrible game leads to family drama. Candy Land: Worst game I've ever played. Games I'm thinking of buying: Ticket to Ride Europe Root 7 Wonder Terraforming Mars (probably too complicaed but looks great) Any thoughts or recommendations from board game fans?
